title: Accept only complete member records
prompt: Write `validMember(value: unknown): boolean`. Return `true` only for an object (not `null`, not an array) with a non-empty string `id` and a boolean `active`. Extra fields are allowed. A single space counts as a non-empty `id`.
hints: Start with a valid record such as `{ id: "A", active: false }`.
Each field must exist and have the right type.
Check `id.length > 0`, and accept both `true` and `false` for `active`.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Checks that the fields exist but not their types.

feedback: Start with a valid record such as `{ id: "A", active: false }`.
